mapper.insert: insert into goodsorder(o_number, o_totalPrice, o_singlePrice, o_status, g_id, id) values (#{number},#{totalPrice},#{singlePrice},#{status},#{goodsId},#{userId})
mapper.select: select goodsorder.o_id id,goods.g_id goodsId, goods.g_name goodsName, goods.g_img1 img1, goodsorder.o_time orderTime, goodsorder.o_number number, goodsorder.o_totalPrice totalPrice, goodsorder.o_singlePrice singlePrice, goodsorder.o_status status, goodsorder.g_id goodsId from goods,user,shop,goodsorder where user.u_phone = #{phone} AND shop.id = user.id AND goods.s_id =shop.s_id AND goodsorder.g_id = goods.g_id AND goodsorder.o_status != 0
select tag.tag_name from tag,ordertag where #{orderId} = ordertag.o_id AND ordertag.tag_id = tag.tag_id

select goodsorder.o_id id,goods.g_id goodsId, goods.g_name goodsName, goods.g_img1 img1, goodsorder.o_time orderTime, goodsorder.o_number number, goodsorder.o_totalPrice totalPrice, goodsorder.o_singlePrice singlePrice, goodsorder.o_status status, goodsorder.g_id goodsId from goods,user,goodsorder where user.u_phone = #{phone} AND goodsorder.id = user.id AND goodsorder.g_id = goods.g_id
